limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).

20 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools: 趣 そく (促 側 則 息 数 束 測 職 and two more), 跳 おどる (踊), 躍 てき (敵 滴 的 適), 載 とし (年 歳 齢; KANJIDIC2 name reading), 載 のり (乗 則 法 準 経 芸; KANJIDIC2 name reading), 載 しるす (印 記 識 録), 輝 あき (秋 空), 輝 さき (先), 輝 てる (両 照), 輝 ひ (日 氷 火 灯 陽), 輝 ひかる (光), 迫 せ (瀬 背), 迫 せる (競), 逸 はや (早 速), 逸 いち (市), 逸 はしる (走), 逸 うしなう (失), 逸 すぐれる (優 勝), 遂 つい (終) and 避 かわす (交); 輝 あき, さき, ひ and ひかる, 迫 せ and 逸 はや are KANJIDIC2 name readings, and the others come from the --extra list.

Two KANJIDIC2 name-only readings can be drawn as wrong reading options only in a Starter practice session that also borrows a specific holder card: 載 のり (KANJIDIC2 name reading): a Starter practice session that also borrows 則, 法 or 準; 輝 ひかる (KANJIDIC2 name reading): a Starter practice session that also borrows 光. Name-only readings are never quizzed.

reading_options.py reports one problem, 迫 せる (--extra list) offered by 競; it does not model curated slots, and reading_exposure.py shows the reading cannot be drawn in any checked pool, because 迫's curated Starter options 出 入 休 fill every wrong slot.
7 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (no JMdict entry id) are pre-existing and out of scope.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed. Six cards quiz only their on reading (趣 シュ, 躍 ヤク, 較 カク, 輩 ハイ, 郡 グン, 郷 キョウ) and nine only their kun reading (跳 は.ねる, 踏 ふ.む, 載 の.る, 輝 かがや.く, 迫 せま.る, 逸 そ.れる, 遂 つい.に, 遣 -づか.い, 避 さ.ける).

Two quizzed readings are outside the official Joyo table, selected because the declaring word article uses them: 逸 そ.れる (逸れる) and 遂 つい.に (遂に); Kanjipedia marks both as outside the table, and both cards say so.
Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.

Some titles share an English word with existing titles in another sense and are not excluded from each other's quiz options, except where a Notes bullet on the card says otherwise. The four pairs of new cards that exclude each other declare it on one card only (躍 lists 跳, 郷 lists 郡, 逸 lists 避, and 踏 lists 遂, added in review), and every exclusion between a new and an existing card is declared on the new card; the app's QuizBuilder applies an exclusion in both directions.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology; component and stroke statements follow the pinned KanjiVG revision.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.
The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell commands or Python, so they can list files as unread that the reports say were read.
Several judgments rest partly on live reads of Digital Daijisen and Kanjipedia pages, not on pinned copies in the packet.
The confirmation reviewers did not re-run the audits; they judged the check outputs that the author ran on the revised snapshot and included in their packets.
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
